content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Bootstrap with Other Build Systems is part of a reproducible delivery workflow. Pin versions, keep source files distinct from generated output, confirm licensing and asset paths, and inspect the built artifacts rather than relying only on a development preview.

content_blocks.code: For another bundler, follow its supported CSS/Sass and JavaScript import rules. Keep the version pinned and confirm that the emitted CSS, fonts, and JavaScript resolve in the production build.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating bootstrap with other build systems as a visual-only change.
common_mistakes.why: A class or style does not automatically add semantic meaning, application logic, or secure server behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Use the appropriate HTML semantics and verify the actual interaction.

common_mistakes.problem: Checking only the default viewport or happy path.
common_mistakes.why: Responsive changes and interaction states can reveal issues that are not visible in a single screenshot.
common_mistakes.fix: Repeat the task at a narrow and a wide viewport and include keyboard/error state checks where relevant.
